headline: Quinnipiac River Linear Trail Advisory Committee to hear subcommittee reports and town engineer update.
summary: The committee will review reports from the Town Engineer and subcommittees covering finances, grants, publicity, signage, and trail expansion. A public question and answer period is also scheduled.
items: Introduction of guests and new members

Subcommittee Reports: Financial Report (Robin Corrigan), Grants/Applications (Mary Mushinsky), Publicity/Social Media (Sally Tremaine, Jay Cosgrove), Signage (Sheila Dravis Cosgrove, Jay Cosgrove, Tom Knight, Melissa Hasselbarth), Trail Expansion (Fred Nellums, Tom Knight, David Bedell)
